captions.detailed: A classic casino-style video slot machine featuring a dark gray cabinet, a slightly recessed main screen, and four colorful buttons (red, green, blue, yellow) on a shallow, angled deck. Below the console is a lockable belly door with a silver vertical hinge handle and a small coin slot. A silver pull lever with a black spherical knob is mounted on the right side of the cabinet. The belly door is designed to swing open on its vertical hinge, and the side pull handle rotates downwards on its pivot.
captions.instruction: Create an articulated 3D model of a casino slot machine cabinet using CadQuery. The model should include a dark main cabinet with an angled screen recess and a button deck holding four colored buttons. It must also feature a functional, rotating belly door at the bottom with a silver handle, and a side-mounted pull lever that pivots on its mounting bracket.
captions.factory: The slot machine is constructed by first extruding a 2D profile to form the main cabinet shell, followed by subtracting a wedge to create the angled screen and button deck. The screen and four colored cylindrical buttons are added as visual parts to the cabinet. A separate 'belly door' part is modeled with a flat box, a cylindrical hinge, and a small coin slot, and is connected to the cabinet using a revolute joint along its vertical edge. The side lever is built as a separate part containing a mounting bracket, a cylindrical arm, and a spherical knob, which is attached to the cabinet's right side via a revolute joint to enable rotational pulling movement.
